alt: A detailed vegetable carving of a devilish face with horns, a long nose, and a wide grin sits on a grassy lawn in front of a chain-link fence.
A detailed vegetable carving of a hedgehog, featuring textured orange and white flesh to mimic spines, rests on a bed of green leafy plants.
A yellow squash intricately carved into a monstrous creature with sharp, claw-like spikes protruding from its body and a detailed, textured face.
A carved vegetable features a grotesque, three-dimensional face with bulging eyes and a wide, toothy grin, set against a dark background.
A carved vegetable features a detailed, menacing face with a furrowed brow, sharp teeth, and pointed ears, set against a green wall.
